description: Extractive by default: the best verified claims for the question assembled with fixed connectives, each quote verbatim with a [n] marker, a Signed citation receipt per claim, and the source list with byte spans. When this node runs a local 1.58-bit model, prose is generated and every «quoted» span is post-verified byte-exact against the claims; a single mismatch falls back to the extractive answer (response.mode says which). Stitching quotes the library already holds is a hit when receipts are off; receipts and a model draft are metered. Free when no verified claim matches. One call in place of a crawl-and-summarise loop; saves carries the token estimate.

receipts.description: A Signed receipt per claim (default true, metered). With false the answer is stitched from quotes the library already holds and is a hit: free within the daily allowance

name: answer
title: Answer a question from verified claims, every sentence a verbatim quote (0.0100 with receipts; without them a hit, free within the allowance, 0.0050 past it)
